title: ComplianceFinding
description: One failed control produced by the OPA evaluation. Output of the Compliance lane, input of Remediation / Reporting / Frontend. Owned by Compliance — see services/compliance/. The `control_id`, `framework`, `title`, `status`, `severity`, `evidence` and `remediation` fields come verbatim out of the Rego `deny` rules (master blueprint §7); `risk_score` is added afterwards by app/risk_scorer.py.

audit_run_id.description: The AuditRun this finding belongs to. Present on persisted findings; absent on the raw Rego output.

control_id.description: Stable identifier of the control, e.g. 'CIS-IOS-1.1.1'. Unique within an audit run.

framework.description: Compliance framework the control belongs to.

title.description: Human-readable control statement shown in the dashboard and PDF report.

status.description: Only failures are emitted — a control absent from the findings list passed. Kept as a field because the PDF report and dashboard render it per row.

severity.description: Assigned in the Rego rule, not derived at runtime, so the verdict stays reproducible.

evidence.description: The specific normalized value that triggered the failure, e.g. 'ssh.version = 1'. This is what makes the verdict auditable.

remediation.description: Filename of the Jinja2 remediation template the Remediation lane should render, e.g. 'ios_ssh_v2_fix.j2'. Null when no template exists yet.

risk_score.description: Severity weight from app/risk_scorer.py. Summed across findings and subtracted from 100 to give the run's compliance_score.

blast_radius.description: Device ids reachable from this finding's device via routing adjacency in the GraphRAG topology graph (app/graph_client.py), out to GRAPH_BLAST_RADIUS_MAX_HOPS. Added by app/evaluator.py, not the Rego rule — empty when the topology graph is unavailable or the device has no known routing neighbors.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp the finding was persisted. Set by Postgres, present on read-back only.
